name: BangBros
summary: Legacy Miami megastudio bundling dozens of high-energy gonzo and reality channels (BangBus, AssParade, Monsters of Cock) into one deep membership vault.
ranking_rationale: Enormous back catalog of Miami-era classics and niche sub-sites under one roof, balanced by cluttered navigation and aggressive upsell funnels.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Massive multi-decade catalog across 50+ themed sub-sites
Strong roster of classic and current mainstream performers
Full HD downloads and streaming included in membership
cons: Older archive scenes vary sharply in video quality
Checkout and member area push frequent add-on upsells
Formulaic gonzo pacing across newer releases

facts.value: Founded 2000 in Miami, Florida; operated by BangBros Network
Dozens of iconic Miami-era channels including BangBus and AssParade
